# 🔄 Skill Swap Hub

A full-stack platform where users exchange skills — no money needed, just knowledge.

## ✨ Features

- **User Authentication** — Signup/login with JWT, profile creation
- **Skill Marketplace** — Browse users, filter by category/location/timezone
- **Smart Matching Algorithm** — Mutual skill match scoring
- **Real-time Chat** — Socket.io powered messaging with typing indicators
- **Video Calls** — Jitsi integration (no install needed, browser-based)
- **Swap Requests** — Accept/reject/complete skill exchange requests
- **Feedback System** — Post-swap reviews with star ratings
- **Gamification** — Points, badges, leaderboard
- **Admin Dashboard** — User management, ban controls, platform stats

---

## 🚀 Quick Start (3 Commands)

### Prerequisites
- **Node.js** v16+ — https://nodejs.org
- **MongoDB** v5+ — https://www.mongodb.com/try/download/community

### Step 1 — Install dependencies
```bash
npm run install-all
```

### Step 2 — Start MongoDB
```bash
# macOS (with Homebrew)
brew services start mongodb-community

# Windows
net start MongoDB

# Linux
sudo systemctl start mongod
```

### Step 3 — Start the app
```bash
npm start
```

Open **http://localhost:3000** in your browser 🎉

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

### Backend (`backend/.env`)
```env
PORT=5000
MONGODB_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017/skillswaphub
JWT_SECRET=your_super_secret_key_here
CLIENT_URL=http://localhost:3000
NODE_ENV=development
```

### Frontend (`frontend/.env`)
```env
REACT_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:5000/api
REACT_APP_SOCKET_URL=http://localhost:5000
```

---

## 🔐 Creating an Admin Account

After registering normally, open MongoDB shell:
```bash
mongosh
use skillswaphub
db.users.updateOne({ email: "your@email.com" }, { $set: { isAdmin: true } })
```

---

## 📁 Project Structure

```
skill-swap-hub/
├── backend/
│   ├── models/        # MongoDB schemas (User, Match, Message, Review)
│   ├── routes/        # REST API endpoints
│   ├── middleware/    # JWT auth middleware
│   └── server.js      # Express + Socket.io server
├── frontend/
│   └── src/
│       ├── components/  # Reusable UI components
│       ├── context/     # Auth + Socket context providers
│       ├── pages/       # All page components
│       └── utils/       # Axios config
└── package.json         # Root scripts
```

---

## 🛣️ API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| POST | /api/auth/register | Register user |
| POST | /api/auth/login | Login |
| GET | /api/auth/me | Get current user |
| PUT | /api/auth/update-profile | Update profile |
| GET | /api/users | Browse users (with filters) |
| GET | /api/users/matches | Get smart matches |
| GET | /api/users/leaderboard | Get top users |
| GET | /api/skills/popular | Get trending skills |
| POST | /api/matches/request | Send swap request |
| PUT | /api/matches/:id/respond | Accept/reject request |
| PUT | /api/matches/:id/complete | Complete a swap |
| GET | /api/messages/:roomId | Get chat history |
| POST | /api/messages | Send a message |
| POST | /api/reviews | Submit a review |
| GET | /api/admin/stats | Admin dashboard stats |

## 🎥 Video Calls

Video calls use **Jitsi Meet** (free, no account needed).
Click "Video Call" in any chat to open a browser-based video room.

---

## 🌐 Deployment

### Frontend → Vercel / Netlify
```bash
cd frontend
npm run build
# Deploy the 'build' folder
```

### Backend → Railway / Render / Heroku
Set environment variables, connect MongoDB Atlas, deploy.

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-----------|
| Frontend | React 18, React Router v6 |
| Styling | Custom CSS (dark theme) |
